metadata.description: Watchdog: a pack of security dogs for Claude Code. Each dog guards one surface.

plugins.name: malinois
plugins.description: Malinois — the VAPT dog. Sniffs out vulnerabilities in source code, web apps, APKs and IPAs, then writes the report. Authorized testing only.

plugins.name: husky
plugins.description: Husky — the cloud dog. Sniffs out misconfigurations in Terraform, Kubernetes, Dockerfiles and CI pipelines. Static review only.

plugins.name: collie
plugins.description: Collie — the AI dog. Sniffs out prompt injection, over-powered agent tools, unsafe model output, RAG leaks and risky MCP config. Static review only.
